Japanese \& Korean Language Teacher – Job Description

**Job Title:** Japanese \& Korean Language Teacher  
**Department:** Foreign Languages / Modern Languages  
**Reports To:** Principal / Academic Coordinator / Head of Department

Job Summary

We are seeking a qualified, passionate, and enthusiastic **Japanese \& Korean Language Teacher** to teach students Japanese and Korean language skills through engaging, interactive, and activity\-based methods. The teacher will develop students’ communication abilities while introducing them to the culture, traditions, and everyday life of Japan and South Korea.

Key Responsibilities

* Plan and deliver engaging Japanese and Korean language lessons according to the school curriculum.
* Develop students’ **speaking, listening, reading, writing, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation** skills.
* Teach **Hiragana, Katakana, basic Kanji**, and Japanese conversation according to students’ levels.
* Teach **Hangul, Korean vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation, and conversational skills**.
* Prepare lesson plans, worksheets, assignments, projects, and study materials.
* Conduct conversation practice, role plays, presentations, quizzes, and language games.
* Conduct regular tests, oral assessments, projects, and classroom evaluations.
* Provide remedial and additional support to students who require assistance.
* Introduce students to Japanese and Korean culture, festivals, traditions, history, food, arts, and social practices.
* Organize language clubs, cultural programs, competitions, quizzes, and other activities.
* Use smart\-class technology, audio\-visual resources, and digital language\-learning tools.
* Maintain accurate attendance, assessment, and student progress records.
* Communicate with parents regarding students’ academic progress when required.
* Participate in examinations, staff meetings, school events, workshops, and teacher\-training programs.
* Encourage students to build confidence and practical communication skills.

Required Qualifications
